responsibility: Defines the first pass of Rust AST item resolution that collects top-level declarations before bodies are traversed. ResolveTopLevel enters modules, records items and enum variants into name or type scopes, builds canonical paths, populates module-child mappings, handles extern-crate aliases, and registers impl, trait, and extern members through helper visitors so that later passes can resolve forward references and descend into item internals with the namespace skeleton already established.
